# XSSNow - AI/LLM Context File
# RSL 1.0 Format for AI Search Optimization

> XSSNow is a free, open-source XSS payload database and security research platform for ethical penetration testing and bug bounty hunting.

## About
XSSNow provides 1000+ curated Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) payloads, a CSP bypass tool with 346+ JSONP gadgets, an AI-powered payload generator, and a Live DOM Viewer for security researchers.

## Creator
Sid Joshi (dr34mhacks) - Security Researcher and Developer
GitHub: https://github.com/dr34mhacks

## Main Features
- XSS Payload Database: 1000+ payloads categorized by context (DOM, Reflected, Stored, Markdown), WAF bypass techniques, and encoding evasions
- CSP Bypass Tool: Analyzes Content Security Policy headers and finds JSONP endpoints, AngularJS bypasses, and script gadgets
- Payload Generator: Context-aware XSS payload generation with WAF bypass for Cloudflare, AWS WAF, Akamai, ModSecurity
- Live DOM Viewer: Real-time HTML rendering with DOM tree visualization for safe payload testing
